title: TestTheBuiltBinaryExitsTwo fails on hosts with pi on PATH, on the epic branch base; yjs on origin/main already fixes it
body: The built binary finds the host's pi on PATH, gets past the no-executor refusal, and dies later with exit 1 — red at base 06c6cabc with my changes stashed. Commit 1bbde871 ("test: the exit-two binary test cannot find the host's executor (yjs)") on origin/main postdates the epic branch base by ~19 minutes and fixes exactly this; any integrated gate on the epic branch stays red until main is folded in.
